5     Numerical experiments
In this section we give some numerical results for the set of extremely abundant numbers up to
its 13770-th element, which is less than C1 = s500,000 (i.e. 500, 000-th superabundant number)
basing on the list provided by T. D. Noe [21]. We examined Property 1 to 4 and Remark 1 below
for the corresponding extremely abundant numbers extracted from the list.
